svg.data-weight: 9.2 kg (20.2 lbs) for the 7280SR3-48YC8, 7280SR3K-48YC8 and 7280SR3K-48YC8A (guide Table 1, data sheet 9.18 kg)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 46.7 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.4 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: eight ports of 100 Gbps; 16 of 50 Gbps; 8 of 40 Gbps; 80 of 25 or 10 Gbps; 48 of 1 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: guide Table 4 typical and maximum; the data sheet says typical is measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (guide Table 2); the data sheet says 5 to 95 percent
svg.data-storage: 8 GB flash (not on the 7280SR3K-48YC8A); 120 GB SSD on the K builds, none on the 7280SR3-48YC8
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 1G, 10G and 25G, in the 48 SFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G, 50G, 40G, 25G and 10G with breakout, in the eight QSFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the rear, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the rear
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA (data sheet)

g.data-description: Table 9 - System Status: blinking green powering up; green normal operations; blue the locator function is active; amber two or more fans disconnected or malfunctioning
g.title: led-system

g.data-description: Table 9 - Fan Status: green all fan and power modules operating normally; amber single fan module removed or malfunctioning; red two or more fans disconnected or malfunctioning
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: Table 9 - PSU Status: green PSU functioning and fully operational; off PSU removed or not operating properly
g.title: led-ps1
